#' Rank street locations by foot traffic during trading hours

rank_locations.Rd

Averages pedestrian counts at each sensor over the chosen trading days, hours and months, then ranks the sensors from busiest to quietest. Use it to compare candidate pop-up locations for the times the shop would actually be open, rather than across the whole day.

Usage

rank_locations(
  data,
  locations,
  days,
  hours = c(10, 18),
  months = month.abb,
  min_days = 292
)

Arguments

data

Average hourly foot traffic, in the format of foot_traffic.

locations

Sensor details, in the format of sensors.

days

Days the shop will trade, as three-letter abbreviations such as c("Sat", "Sun").

hours

Opening and closing time on the 24-hour clock. c(10, 18) means 10am to 6pm, so the last hour counted is 5pm to 6pm.

months

Months to include, as three-letter abbreviations such as c("Nov", "Dec"). Defaults to all twelve.

min_days

Minimum number of days a sensor must have reported in the year for its average to be treated as reliable. Defaults to 292, which is 80% of the year.

Value

A tibble with one row per sensor, busiest first, with columns rank, location_id, location_name, avg_per_hour (average pedestrians per hour during the trading window), hours_observed (number of hourly readings behind that average), days_observed (days the sensor reported in the year), limited_data (TRUE when days_observed is below min_days, so the average should be read with caution), latitude and longitude.

Examples

# Weekend trading, 10am to 6pm, all year
rank_locations(foot_traffic, sensors, days = c("Sat", "Sun"))
#> # A tibble: 100 × 9
#>     rank location_id location_name     avg_per_hour hours_observed days_observed
#>    <int>       <dbl> <chr>                    <dbl>          <int>         <int>
#>  1     1           4 Town Hall (West)          3291            816           363
#>  2     2          41 Flinders La-Swan…         2966            832           363
#>  3     3          66 QV2 Apartments, …         2459            816           363
#>  4     4          35 Southbank Promen…         2418            832           365
#>  5     5           5 Princes Bridge            2349            832           365
#>  6     6           1 Bourke Street Ma…         2338            304           134
#>  7     7           3 Melbourne Central         2310            832           365
#>  8     8          84 Elizabeth St - F…         1980            832           365
#>  9     9         184 124 Elizabeth St…         1976            832           365
#> 10    10          47 Melbourne Centra…         1898            832           365
#> # ℹ 90 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: limited_data <lgl>, latitude <dbl>, longitude <dbl>

# Weekday lunch trade in the Christmas season
rank_locations(
  foot_traffic, sensors,
  days = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"),
  hours = c(11, 15),
  months = c("Nov", "Dec")
)
#> # A tibble: 100 × 9
#>     rank location_id location_name     avg_per_hour hours_observed days_observed
#>    <int>       <dbl> <chr>                    <dbl>          <int>         <int>
